name: Steal a magic 🔮
desc:
In a world full of roaming Skills...
Only the fastest and smartest players can collect the most powerful skills!

✨ How to Play:
– 🔮 Skills appear and move around the map
– 💰 Buy Skill before others can grab it
– ⚔️ Use your Skills to battle, troll, or show off
– ♻️ Rebirth to increase your max health and gain other benefits
– 🧙 Become the strongest Skill wielder in the server!

– 💸 Remember: You earn money even while you're offline!
